result:
Integration test collection errors pre-exist, unrelated to prune.py — not touched.

Two bugs found and fixed in `src/verityai/context/prune.py`:

1. **`dropped_critical` never populated.** Line 108 unconditionally reset it to `[]` even when `budget_met` is `False`, so the field never told a caller which critical items caused overage. Fixed: now set to `[item.id for item in current if item.is_protected]` when over budget.

2. **Tiebreak sort backwards.** `-i.original_index` ascending put newest first among ties, so newest got dropped first — opposite of the docstring's "oldest goes before the newest." Fixed key to `i.original_index` (ascending, oldest first).

Added 3 regression tests in `tests/unit/test_prune.py`, all pass (24/24), full unit suite green (551 passed).
